source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed, complete) Filled 2026-10-01 from the kenyanstocks.com comprehensive income API: Income Tax FY2022 from the source line Income Tax Charge; Income Tax FY2023 from the source line Income Tax Charge; Income Tax FY2024 from the source line Income Tax Charge; Income Tax FY2025 from the source line Income Tax Charge. KEGN FY2026 (year ended 30 June 2026) column filled from KenGen audited financial results for the year ended 30 June 2026, condensed statement of profit or loss, page 1, published 7 September 2026 (https://www.kengen.co.ke/download/kengen-full-year-financial-results-2025-2026/): revenue less reimbursable expenses 49,511 KShs million (the same net-of-reimbursables basis the 2022 to 2025 columns use), operating profit 14,174, finance costs 1,982, profit before tax 15,053, income tax 4,700, profit after tax 10,353, EPS 1.57. Arithmetic checked on the printed column: 15,053 less 4,700 equals 10,353, and 14,174 plus finance income 2,861 less finance costs 1,982 equals 15,053. The FY2026 column also reordered to first so the newest year leads, as in every other NSE file. FY2023 and FY2022 operating profit are derived, not printed: PBT less finance income plus finance costs gives 9,568,116 thousand and 6,079,807 thousand, and the same identity reproduces the stored FY2024 and FY2025 operating profit to within 0.01 per cent. KenGen prints no cost of sales and no gross profit line.
